question: I'd like to know the relationship between Crusch-sama and his highness in Re: Zero Academy.
answer: I didn't have the mental image of his highness being in Re: Zero Academy, but if he was there, he'd become the head of an organization opposed to the student council, make futile efforts to get Crusch-sama to stop wearing men's clothes, and when Crusch-sama tells him "You're a hopeless person, you are." and smiles at him, he'd be satisfied.
